info.title: Shellwright control plane
info.description:
Organisations, apps, and immutable configuration versions.

Errors are RFC 9457 problem documents. The `type` URI and the `code` extension are stable; the `title` and `detail` are for people and may be reworded.

post.summary: Create an account and send a verification link.
Exchange credentials for an access token and a refresh cookie.
Rotate the refresh cookie and issue a new access token.
Send a password reset link, if the address is known.
Set a new password using an emailed token.

get.summary: Begin sign-in through an external identity provider.
Finish an external sign-in and hand back a Shellwright session.
List the organisations the caller belongs to.

post.summary: Create an organisation and become its owner.

put.summary: Grant or change a member's role.

post.summary: Mint an API token and show the secret once.
Create an app and seed its first configuration.
Upload an image and get back an asset reference.
Start a build. Requires an Idempotency-Key.
Ask a running build to stop.

get.summary: Get a short-lived download link for a finished build.
Download an artifact using a signed link.
